description: Remove a shot (shot_id, or scene + shot) or a whole scene (scene alone, or its id). A scene's only shot can't be removed alone (remove the scene), and the last scene can't go. One undo step for the person. Returns { done }. To take a person or object out of a shot, use set_cast with op remove.

id.description: Or: a shot id or a scene id from get_project.

scene.description: Scene index from 0. Alone: the whole scene; with shot: that shot.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

name: remove
